people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Bezer
people.line: Levitical city of refuge in Reuben

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Golan
people.line: A city of refuge in Bashan, allotted to Manasseh.

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

people.name: Ramoth
people.line: City of refuge east of the Jordan

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.
translations.bsb: Bezer in the wilderness on the plateau belonging to the Reubenites, Ramoth in Gilead belonging to the Gadites, or Golan in Bashan belonging to the Manassites.
translations.kjv: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.
translations.asv: namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, for the Manassites.
